title: FIPS gate missing: wolfssl sess_reset (all 5 algorithms)
description: sess_reset is a gated callback per crypto2dev_provider.h. All 5 wolfssl sess_reset implementations call no fips_gate(). Affected: wolfssl_aes_cbc_sess_reset (aes_cbc.c:130), wolfssl_aes_gcm_sess_reset (aes_gcm.c:129), wolfssl_cmac_sess_reset (cmac.c:105), wolfssl_hmac_sess_reset (hmac.c:171), wolfssl_sha_sess_reset (sha.c:177). Each begins with context validity checks before any gate call. Trigger: user calls RESET ioctl on an active session while FIPS module is degraded. Outcome: session state re-initializes (reinitializing wolfCrypt state) without operational status check — FIPS compliance violation.
close_reason: Added wolfssl_fips_gate() as first statement in all 5 wolfssl sess_reset implementations
